## Overview

This directory contains Amazon EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service) specific standards for enterprise environments. These standards provide comprehensive guidance for cluster configuration, deployment patterns, security policies, and operational practices to ensure consistent and secure Kubernetes workloads.

These standards ensure consistent, secure, and scalable Amazon EKS deployments across the platform. They complement the general infrastructure and application standards with Kubernetes-specific guidance for:

- Cluster configuration and node group management
- Container deployment and scaling strategies
- Helm chart development and package management
- Network policies and ingress configuration
- Security policies and access control
- Monitoring and observability setup
- Resource management and optimization
